authority: Y.-K. Kim, Compact Fitting Formulas for Electron-Impact Cross Sections, J. Res. NIST 97 (1992) 689–692, Eq. (2), Table 1, https://doi.org/10.6028/jres.097.032
empirical_fit_to: M. B. Shah, D. S. Elliott, H. B. Gilbody, Pulsed crossed-beam study of the ionisation of atomic hydrogen by electron impact, J. Phys. B 20 (1987) 3501, https://doi.org/10.1088/0022-3700/20/14/022
formula: sigma(E)=(1e-20 m²/x){A ln x+[B ln x+C(x-1)]/(x+D)}, x=E/13.61 eV; set 0 if x<=1
C_sign: POSITIVE, checked by physical threshold derivative and source paper Eq(2) Table 1; OCR table dash is a column separator
scope: one-electron total atomic H(1s) impact ionization near 13.61-20.99 eV; not differential/stopping rate
cross_check: NIST SRD107 BEB https://doi.org/10.18434/T4KK5C model, not calibrated experimental replacement
